name: Sussex County, DE
findings: Sussex County has 781 nonprofit organizations. 311 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 241 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sussex County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.
